inspection_method.operation: Node fs reads and SHA-256 of installed public package source only; no Pi imports, CLI invocation, session construction or prompts.

version_install.qualification_gap: Harbor installs Node major22 via nvm and npm --ignore-scripts; the lab uses Node24.13.1 and intentionally enables the dependency install script for koffi. Cold install/runtime or a dedicated frozen image must be qualified.

openai_cli_fallback.conclusion: The exact dated ID is accepted by fallback logic, but its inherited pricing/context differ from the mini family. Model-ID rejection is not the blocker; metadata correctness is.

harbor_generated_fields: reasoning when reasoning_effort is not None/off
custom_endpoint.conclusion: A Harbor base_url/model_api route creates a separate harbor-endpoint provider and overwrites models.json under /tmp/harbor-pi-agent; direct-provider configuration must not be assumed to apply.

limits_and_defaults.harbor_max_turns: Extension appends a budget sentence to the system prompt and aborts after the configured count of completed turns. Not a hard dollar cap.
limits_and_defaults.lab_max_turns: SDK subscriber aborts at the limit only when the final message contains tool calls.
limits_and_defaults.harbor_retry_and_compaction: Not disabled by this adapter; Pi source defaults compaction enabled and retry enabled with maxRetries3.
limits_and_defaults.reasoning_default: Pi medium; explicitly set Harbor reasoning_effort=medium in a pilot instead of relying on defaults.

accounting.harbor: ATIF/native-session conversion sums available metrics and converts nonpositive costs to null; missing token components can contribute zero.
accounting.lab: Requires a complete final trace and complete usage; otherwise emits null with a reason.
accounting.required_pilot_check: Compare raw message/session usage, ATIF and provider billing; never treat fallback/catalog estimates as authoritative bill reconciliation.

proposed_metadata_delivery.status: source-supported design; not implemented, installed or runtime-qualified
proposed_metadata_delivery.reason: Pi does not declare native_config; BaseInstalledAgent rejects config.

conditions: No Harbor base_url or model_api override
Fresh dedicated non-root HOME with no host auth/settings mounted
No inherited PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR override; verify effective directory
Frozen artifact hashes and observed version checked before model execution
direct_provider_route.mechanism: Bake non-secret models.json and settings.json into the dedicated agent HOME at .pi/agent/. Native Pi reads them; no Harbor adapter patch is required.
direct_provider_route.separate_limit_choice: Set max_turns from the future synthetic contract; record the injected budget prompt and native CLI semantics.
direct_provider_route.gate: Before paid execution, verify native registry selects exact dated ID with mini-family metadata and effective settings in the frozen image. Verify emitted request/model and billing in the authorized live pilot.

proposed_metadata_delivery.custom_base_url_route: Blocked pending a separate design and offline proof for complete metadata in Harbor-generated /tmp/harbor-pi-agent/models.json. Prebaked ~/.pi/agent files alone are bypassed. No silent custom endpoint or model alias substitution.
proposed_metadata_delivery.comparison_condition: Even with matching model metadata and retries disabled, Harbor Pi is CLI plus Harbor extension/session handling, separate from the lab SDK condition.
